title: The 1909 secret code that controls every flight in MSFS
description:
Discover why a 1909 secret code controls every flight in Microsoft Flight Simulator. In this in-depth MSFS tutorial, we explore the Kollsman window, altimeter settings like QNH vs QFE, and how standard pressure keeps transcontinental traffic safely separated.

If you've ever wondered how barometric pressure affects your vertical navigation, or why misdialing your subscale puts you thousands of feet lower than you think, this Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 and MSFS 2020 guide breaks down everything you need to know for offline flying and VATSIM procedures.

⏱️ Video Chapters:
00:00 - The 2,000-Foot Mistake (The Altimeter Trap)
01:07 - The Ground Calibration Test (QFE)
03:22 - The Mountain Ridge Danger Zone (QNH)
03:59 - The 1909 secret code that started it all
05:07 - Cruising above the clouds: standard pressure & flight levels
06:43 - Lateral Navigation & Modern NOTAMs

✈️ Hardware & Platform:
- Simulators: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 / Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020
- Aircraft Featured: General Aviation & Commercial Airliners
